full_name: Veterans Affairs Low Vision Visual Functioning Questionnaire
domains: daily activities incl. reading, mobility, daily living, visual information (item list Table 2 p4)
response_scale: Q1 'Is it difficult to ...?' not difficult / slightly-moderately difficult / extremely difficult / impossible / do not do it for nonvisual reasons (missing); categories 2 and 3 combined after threshold disordering
scoring: Rasch (Andrich Rating Scale Model, Winsteps) person measure in logits
target_population: visually impaired adults seeking low vision rehabilitation services incl. legally blind veterans
notes: Telephone interviewer-administered with written script; four questions asked per item but only Q1 analysed (p2); administration time 25-35 min for all four questions (p5; not given as single typical value so left NR); validation (valid and reliable) cited to earlier papers not detailed here (p2); this paper tests sensitivity to change and DIF (7 of 48 items)
